source_family: CIIS official CFFEX Level-2 Snapshot historical delivery (legacy positional XLSX/CSV)

evidence.note: The delivered public sample workbook has no header row; columns are positional per manual 6.6.1.

zero_quote_semantics: BidPrice1 and AskPrice1 equal to 0.0 with zero BidVolume1/AskVolume1 encode no two-sided executable quote in this legacy snapshot layout.
derived_trading_status_rule: Native CFF snapshot 6.6.1 has no TradingPhase/InstrumentStatus column. DerivedQuoteStatus is computed only from exchange-local DateTime session windows (09:30-11:30, 13:00-15:00) and top-of-book zeros; it is not a native exchange status feed.
volume_semantics: Volume is the exchange snapshot cumulative day volume field (contracts) as documented in CIIS manual 6.6.1.
open_interest_semantics: OpenInterest is contracts outstanding at snapshot time per CIIS manual 6.6.1.
master_expiry_rule: Provisional contract-month third-Friday mapping used only for schema verification on the public sample; full admission requires an authoritative exchange contract master or delivered expiry field.
